reason: Attachment is a tab in a roving-tabindex tablist: Tab stops only on the selected tab, and End and the arrow keys select the others. From the default panel, Tab, Tab, End selects Attachment and shows its All, Has and Does not have options in 3 keys, and in its own state Tab goes Reset, then the selected Attachment tab.
criterionAnalysis: 2.1.1 Keyboard does not fail: the Attachment section opens from the keyboard (3 keys: Tab, Tab, End; screenshot cited). A manual Tab walk from the menu root in its own state goes Reset, Attachment tab, options; the focus probe is not cited because its scope here was the inner Legend layer and it focused the tab directly. The sweep's trace ran on a panel opened on Date, where the unselected Attachment tab is skipped by Tab by design (APG roving tabindex). 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value does not fail: the tab exposes role tab, name Attachment and its selected state (probe-a289dc267282). 2.1.2 No Keyboard Trap does not fail: Shift+Tab and Tab leave the panel. 2.4.3 Focus Order does not fail for this claim: Tab order is Reset, the selected tab, then the panel, matching the visual order. Arrow selection of tabs that have a search field (Keyword, Category, Team Member, Budget, Card and others) moves focus into the panel's first field and can leave the previous panel on screen. That is a separate focus-order and change-of-context question (2.4.3, 3.2.2), not this claim, and it is not judged here.
